Check the new version of Phantom Signal!

notes.title: Hot fix 1.03 (Update)
notes.notes:
Hot Fix 1.03 is here,

ːcwd_heartːPlease check it out and let us know if something is not rightːcwd_heartː,

ːgg_instrumentsːDifficulty levelːgg_instrumentsː

All casual players this is for you,  we encourage you to finish the game on our new Normal level - its supposed to be easy!  If not let us know, we`ll help you!        

-We received a lots of feedbacks about "casual"  difficulty,  and now easy level - is normal (but its still easy) 

-If you decided to start on Hard  you can can continue on Normal if you stuck, and this will not reset your progress 

ːgg_instrumentsːEnemiesːgg_instrumentsː

- We added enemies count on minimap, check it out!

ːgg_instrumentsːResearchːgg_instrumentsː

We added research reset button,  so you can now grab unique combination to finish the level
